```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_absolute_error,
    mean_squared_error,
    r2_score
)

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

```


```{python}
# import your data here using polars and the URL
dwelling_url = "https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4dwellings/raw/master/data-raw/dwellings_ml/dwellings_ml.csv"

neighborhood_url = "https://github.com/byuidatascience/data4dwellings/raw/master/data-raw/dwellings_neighborhoods_ml/dwellings_neighborhoods_ml.csv"

df = pl.read_csv(dwelling_url)
neighborhoods = pl.read_csv(neighborhood_url)

housing = df.join(
    neighborhoods,
    on="parcel",
    how="left"
)

housing.head()

```

```{python}
numeric_cols = [
    "livearea",
    "finbsmnt",
    "basement",
    "yrbuilt",
    "totunits",
    "stories",
    "nocars",
    "numbdrm",
    "numbaths",
    "sprice"
]

housing_num = housing.select(numeric_cols)

X1 = df.drop(["parcel", "yrbuilt"]).to_numpy()

y1 = df["yrbuilt"].to_numpy()

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X1,
    y1,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42
)

model1 = RandomForestRegressor(
    n_estimators=100,
    random_state=42
)

model1.fit(X_train, y_train)

pred1 = model1.predict(X_test)

mae1 = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred1)
rmse1 = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, pred1))
r21 = r2_score(y_test, pred1)

print("Original Data")
print("MAE =", round(mae1,2))
print("RMSE =", round(rmse1,2))
print("R² =", round(r21,3))
```

```{python}
X2 = housing.drop(["parcel", "yrbuilt"]).to_numpy()

y2 = housing["yrbuilt"].to_numpy()

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X2,
    y2,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42
)

model2 = RandomForestRegressor(
    n_estimators=100,
    random_state=42
)

model2.fit(X_train, y_train)

pred2 = model2.predict(X_test)

mae2 = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred2)
rmse2 = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, pred2))
r22 = r2_score(y_test, pred2)

print("Neighborhood Data")
print("MAE =", round(mae2,2))
print("RMSE =", round(rmse2,2))
print("R² =", round(r22,3))
```
